intro: Good evening, gentlemen. Gameweek 1 is done. Results included Arsenal 3-0 Coventry City, Hull City 2-0 Man Utd and Everton 2-0 Crystal Palace. Asher top-scored with 80; Brahmes managed 28. Asher leads on 80, 21 clear of Ben. Make of that what you will.
motw: Asher scored 80, the best of the week. De Cuyper (17), Gakpo (12) and White (11) did the heavy lifting. Now 1st on 80.
stinker: 28 points. That's the lot. Rogers top-scored with 8, which tells you how the rest went.
bench: 10 points left on the bench. Trafford (9) and Hill (1) watched from the side. Team selection remains an art, not a science.
bench_jam: Amad didn't play, so Dewsbury-Hall came off Jonny's bench and scored 11. 1 goal and 3 bonus. Luck is a skill if you say it confidently.
gloves: Lammens (Man Utd) scored 1 for Brahmes. Conceded 2. Made 2 saves, for what it's worth.
